                    | was trying to finish my essay for my English class by the end of the week, but it all seemed to be
                    going at a snail’s pace and | was not very motivated. So | decided to take the bull by the horns.
                    | stayed up until after midnight every day for four days and worked on my essay. | was tired in the
                    mornings, and went  round like a bear with a sore head all day, but, in the end | managed to kill
                    two  birds with one stone: | finished the essay and | read a number of important books | should
                    have read weeks ago. My last essay was a bit of a dog’s breakfast, but I’m hoping this one will get
                    a better grade.
